Record Class BookingData

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
grafioschtrader.report.pdf.BookingData
Record Components:
addedBackTax - withholding tax added back to dividend income because the tenant excludes it; it is part of the position contributions but was never credited to an account, so the reconciliation removes it
public record BookingData(List<BookingData.Booking> transactions, List<BookingData.Position> positions, double fees, double interest, double accountTransactionCosts, int missingRates, double addedBackTax) extends Record
Period bookings and their attribution. Unknown rates propagate through affected sums as NaN, never as zero.

      public final boolean equals(Object o)
      Indicates whether some other object is "equal to" this one. The objects are equal if the other object is of the same class and if all the record components are equal. Reference components are compared with Objects::equals(Object,Object); primitive components are compared with the compare method from their corresponding wrapper classes.
